body:
I couldn't recreate this as described on my machine. Do you mind being a bit more verbose in your steps to reproduce or uploading a godot project instead of just the texture file?

Godot v4.4.stable (4c311cbee) - Windows 11 (build 22621) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7270) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700K CPU @ 4.00GHz (8 threads)

version: v4.4.stable.steam [4c311cbee]

<details>
<summary>My steps taken to attempt to reproduce</summary>

* Installed godot from steam.
* launched godot through steam.
* created a new project with mobile renderer
* dragged "example_texture.png" into the project.
* opened the import pane, set mode to "VRAM Compressed", set MipMaps->Generate to "On" 
* clicked re-import
* created a 3d scene, a mesh instance 3d, and dragged the png onto a mesh.
* right clicked "example_texture.png" and clicked re-import to see if that'd be any different.
* clicked random import settings and re-imported randomly a couple times

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/25daa1a1-9060-4963-9790-632be12184c4)
</details>

I understand that the standard practice is to give a verbose description of how to replicate; but it truly is any situation in which the "reimporting assets" progress popup appears in regards to a texture, of any format. New project, old project, changing settings, not changing settings, done automatically when applied to a 3D object or not; It's an omnipresent bug that doesn't require any specific line of things happening. It's most likely a hardware issue on my side.

All good, if it's a really big issue, it's a bit of extra work, but building from source with `scons dev_build=yes` will build with debug symbols. This will populate those `[1] error(-1): no debug info in PE/COFF executable` entries with traces back to lines of code. This may not be useful if it's truly a hardware issue, but if it is a software issue, then this might get us on the right track to figure out what's going on.

More resources on building from source:
https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/contributing/development/compiling/compiling_for_windows.html#doc-compiling-for-windows

Calinou also releases builds with debug symbols (last release is 4.3 though, if the issue is recreatable on 4.3, this could work too):
https://github.com/Calinou/godot-debug-builds/releases

Good luck!
